correctness.rationale: Degree-3 internal vertex neighbourhoods force hub-colour avoidance and period-two inequality c(i-1)!=c(i+1), with endpoints forcing the remaining avoidances. Hub condition is precisely a cap floor(n/2) on each path-colour frequency. For 3 colours this gives a balanced binary period-4 sequence exactly for even n; for odd n the hub needs three nonhub colours, and cyclic 123 construction works. The product of inventory polynomials on the odd and even path positions classifies and counts all named four-colour optima. The verifier independently exhausts actual neighbourhoods for n<=9 and checks n<=100 constructions.
